matches.rationale: No finding addresses the abstract's overstatement that using the closed-form "can even improve performance" without sufficient qualification. The only findings touching the abstract (pred_ids 6, 7) discuss different claim distortions.

The ground truth is that the introduction cites future works as established without clarifying their speculative status. Pred_id 9 points out inconsistent publication labels (anticipated/manuscript/forthcoming vs. published), which is a different bibliographic inconsistency, not the misleading absence of qualification.
No finding identifies the missing normalization/softmax in the closed-form velocity field in the Preliminaries. Pred_id 4 deals with a missing 1/n factor in the appendix, a different technical error.
No finding mentions the omission of data augmentation details. Pred_id 8 discusses missing sampling protocol details (ODE solver, etc.), not augmentation.
No finding describes the truncated/rescaled nearest-neighbor distances in Figure 2 or the missing error bars. Pred_ids 5 and 8 address different evidence and experimental-design issues.

Pred_id 1 directly captures the contradiction in Proposition 2 claiming unbiasedness while later retracting it, exactly the method-logic inconsistency about the unbiasedness of the Monte Carlo estimator when including the current sample.
The ground truth points to a specific rhetorical overstatement in the description of Figure 4 ('consistent modest but steady improvements'). No finding flags this phrasing or its marketing tone.
The conclusion's overstatement relative to unexplored limitations is not raised by any finding. The self-contradiction between claimed progress and admitted limitations is not discussed.
The omission of a thorough privacy-risk discussion in the broader impact section is not identified by any finding. The ethical-integrity gap goes unmentioned.
No finding criticizes the claim that empirical flow matching remains significantly more efficient than increasing batch size by M; the computational-efficiency understatement is not covered.
The omitted results for M > 1000 (claiming near-identical performance) are not flagged. None of the findings mention this evidence-suppression or the missing large-M data.
The promotional language in Related Work ('remarkable agreement', 'clearly answers') is not addressed by any finding. The rhetorical tone is not among the listed errors.

The internal contradiction between Section 3.1's claim that the stochastic phase is short and earlier emphasis on stochasticity is not noted. Pred_id 7 argues the conclusion on stochasticity is too strong, but does not identify the cross-section narrative misalignment.
